question: What type of employment relationship does TriageLogic establish with its employees in the Policy and Procedure Manual?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic establishes an at-will employment relationship. Nothing in the manual or other documents should be construed to create an employment agreement or contract for anything other than at-will employment.

question: How often must the Employee Personnel File Checklist be updated according to Core 26?
ground_truth_answer: The checklist of documents to be in each employee personnel file must be updated annually as mandated by CORE 26.

question: What mandatory documents must be maintained in each employee personnel file at TriageLogic?
ground_truth_answer: Each employee personnel file must include: CV or Application, Job Description, Employment Contract or Contractor Agreement, W4 or I-9 Form, IRA form, signed Confidentiality Statement Form, Licensure/Certification verification/attestation, Proof of Current License, Proof of Liability Insurance, Orientation/Training documentation, Signed HIPAA Compliance Policy, URAC and State Regulatory Training, and Yearly Performance Evaluations.

question: How frequently are employee performance appraisals conducted at TriageLogic?
ground_truth_answer: Employee performance evaluations are conducted annually (yearly performance evaluations), with an initial 90-day employee review for new hires.

question: What are the core rating factors evaluated during employee performance appraisals?
ground_truth_answer: The performance appraisal assesses Job Knowledge, Quality of Work (accuracy and neatness), Productivity (prioritization, meeting deadlines, self-starter), Dependability (handling instructions with little direction), and alignment with company values including gossip prevention and compassion.

question: Who coordinates media inquiries and serves as the official spokesperson for TriageLogic?
ground_truth_answer: Outside inquiries regarding TriageLogic must be referred to the CEO. The CEO serves as the official information channel for news media and external organizations, responsible for approving press releases, responding to media inquiries, and coordinating interviews.

question: What attestation regarding HIPAA must staff sign upon receiving the Policy and Procedure manual?
ground_truth_answer: Staff must sign an attestation confirming receipt of the most recent Company Policy and Procedure Manual, confirming they were reminded about HIPAA as it applies to their position, and confirming they had an opportunity to ask questions.

question: What systems are authorized by TriageLogic for recordkeeping and document management?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic authorizes recordkeeping and document management in paper form, SugarSync, and in its Call Center Software System, managed under the office of the CEO.

question: What is the purpose of the Written Business Agreements and Client Contract Review policy (Policy #8)?
ground_truth_answer: Policy #8 governs written business agreements to ensure that client contracts define the scope of telephone triage services, service level agreements, confidentiality, and responsibilities, and undergo regular administrative review.

question: What program does TriageLogic maintain to oversee delegated business activities (Core 6-9)?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic maintains a Delegation Oversight Program (Policy #7) to review and evaluate potential delegates before contracting, establish written delegation agreements, and conduct ongoing oversight and annual review of delegated functions.

question: How does TriageLogic collect feedback on client and end-user satisfaction under Core 12?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic monitors satisfaction using client satisfaction surveys and patient evaluation surveys, evaluated regularly by the Client Relations Manager and reviewed by the Quality Management Committee.

question: What channels do clients use to forward calls to TriageLogic telephone triage service?
ground_truth_answer: Client agreements provide a toll-free line which the client uses to forward patient calls to the triage system according to pre-agreed coverage hours or via contracted medical answering services.
expected_sources: Core 34: Client and Consumer Access to Services

question: Who reviews and updates company policies and procedures, and where are changes documented?
ground_truth_answer: Policies and procedures are established and revised by authorized officers and management under Core 3, with version numbers, effective dates, and review dates tracked and approved by the CEO.

question: What are the rules regarding the use of company email by employees under Document Management Policy #2?
ground_truth_answer: The company email system is company property and is subject to monitoring at all times for employee protection and company property rights. All communications are subject to confidentiality and company policies.

question: What emergency support SLA must software vendors provide under TriageLogic Business Continuity Plan (Core 14d)?
ground_truth_answer: The software vendor must provide 24/7 emergency support 365 days a year for any software or server related issues, with a mandatory response time of 30 minutes for emergency support issues.

question: How often must the entire software and server system be tested for business continuity and security vulnerabilities?
ground_truth_answer: The entire system must be tested at least once every 2 years to identify potential business continuity issues (server attacks, viruses) and assess potential vulnerabilities and integrity including HIPAA compliance testing.

question: Who is responsible for contacting vendor emergency support when technical issues arise at the call center?
ground_truth_answer: The Nurse Manager on call is responsible for accessing the emergency support system as needed when technical or server issues occur.

question: How does TriageLogic electronic triage software safeguard finalized patient charts against alteration?
ground_truth_answer: The software platform has built-in controls to prevent alteration of a completed patient chart after it has been finalized, ensuring medical record integrity and auditability.

question: How frequently does TriageLogic meet with its software vendor to assess potential security and system risks?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic meets with its software vendor weekly to assess potential security, performance, and infrastructure risks.

question: What type of triage system architecture does TriageLogic utilize for operations?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic utilizes an electronic Triage System with centralized call queueing, role-based access, and secure server infrastructure.

question: What work environment requirements must remote clinical nurse users verify during orientation?
ground_truth_answer: Remote clinical nurse users must verify: 1) A dedicated room where they can work alone while taking calls or accessing the system; 2) A quiet environment without background noise audible to callers; and 3) High speed internet access (DSL, Cable, or Satellite).

question: What minimum personal details are required in every user system profile at TriageLogic?
ground_truth_answer: Each user system profile must contain: First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Home Zip Code, and Home or Cell Phone Number.

question: What is the required IT offboarding procedure when an employee leaves TriageLogic or replaces a computer?
ground_truth_answer: The IT relations manager coordinates a WebEx session with an IT team representative who accesses the user computer remotely and securely removes all relevant company and patient data according to IT security standards.

question: Who has authority to grant permission to create a Nurse Manager user account in the system?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic IT customer service representatives can only create a Nurse Manager account with written permission from the Medical Director or the CEO.

question: When are Nurse Managers authorized to create a nurse user account for clinical calls?
ground_truth_answer: Nurse Managers are permitted to create a nurse user account only after the nurse has completed their orientation checklist.

question: What access controls are enforced on staff accessing Protected Health Information (PHI)?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic enforces role-based access control (RBAC), unique usernames and passwords for each user, strict password standards, and comprehensive audit logging of any view or edit actions in the system.

question: What is TriageLogic policy regarding financial incentives, bonuses, or reimbursement for clinical staff under Core 33?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic does NOT have any system for reimbursement, bonuses, or financial incentives based on consumer utilization of healthcare services. Triage nurses are paid on an hourly or fixed salary basis and are never incentivized to limit patient care or affect triage decisions.

question: How are triage call center nurses compensated at TriageLogic?
ground_truth_answer: Nurses who take calls for the call center are either employees paid an hourly or fixed salary, or independent contractors paid an agreed hourly rate.
expected_sources: Core 33: Financial Incentives of Clinical Staff

question: What primary source verification and re-credentialing frequency is required for clinical practitioners under Core 30?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic verifies current licensure and certification upon hire from primary sources (e.g. state boards of nursing or medicine) and thereafter no later than scheduled expiration and no less than every three years.

question: What qualifications and experience are required for the Medical Director position under Core 31?
ground_truth_answer: The Medical Director must hold a current unrestricted medical license, board certification, and a minimum of five (5) years of post-graduate direct patient care experience.

question: What licensing compact must Registered Nurses satisfy prior to providing triage services?
ground_truth_answer: All RNs must provide proof of current licensure as a Registered Nurse in a Nurse Licensure Compact State and maintain valid proof through renewal.

question: Who are the members of TriageLogic Advisory Board and what are their background credentials?
ground_truth_answer: The Advisory Board includes Dr. Charu Raheja, PhD (Chair and CEO, PhD in Finance from NYU, specializing in corporate governance and healthcare research) and Dr. Ravi Raheja, MD (Medical Director and COO, MD from Robert Wood Johnson Medical School, pediatric residency at Schneider Children Hospital).

question: What are the combined responsibilities of the Medical Director across clinical protocols, quality management, and complaints?
ground_truth_answer: The Medical Director reviews and approves all telephone triage protocols, oversees clinical quality indicators on the Quality Management Committee, resolves grievances from participating physicians or triage staff, and reports complaint trends to the quality committee at least annually.

question: How are patient complaints processed from initial client report through resolution and quality oversight under Core 35?
ground_truth_answer: Complaints are received through the client relations manager, who informs the client of resolution steps and offers direct access to the Medical Director. An incident report is filed, tracked in SugarSync, and reported by the Medical Director to the Quality Management Committee at least once a year.
expected_sources: Core 35: Complaint Process and Incident Reporting

question: How does TriageLogic address consumer safety for life-threatening calls and ensure health literacy in consumer communications under Core 38 and Core 40?
ground_truth_answer: Under Core 38, potentially life, limb or vision threatening calls are triaged as Urgent and directed to emergency care/911 with a clinical manager available 24/7. Under Core 40, all consumer materials must be written in plain language, readability is measured, and staff are trained in plain language communication.
expected_sources: Core 38 & 40: Consumer Protection and Health Literacy

question: When and where was TriageLogic legally incorporated, and what URAC standards does the policy manual cover?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic was incorporated as a legal entity in November 2006 in Nashville, Tennessee, and the manual covers URAC Core Standards 1 through 40.

question: What is the reimbursement limit for employee pet insurance under TriageLogic benefits?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic company manual does not cover or provide pet insurance reimbursement.

question: Can employees choose to receive part of their monthly salary in Bitcoin or Ethereum cryptocurrency?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic company records contain no provision for cryptocurrency payroll or payment in Bitcoin or Ethereum.

question: How many months of paid sabbatical leave are employees eligible for after five years of service?
ground_truth_answer: TriageLogic policies do not mention or provide sabbatical leave benefits.

question: What is the monthly corporate subsidy for employee gym and fitness club memberships?
ground_truth_answer: There is no corporate gym or fitness membership subsidy mentioned in TriageLogic company policy manual.
